newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One near-term cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banc One near-term cut.

text.p: -- Brown Bros Harriman said it cut its near-term view on Banc One Corp view to hold from buy
-- Analyst Nancy Bush simultaneously raised the 12-month view on Banc One to outperfrom from market performer
-- Analyst lowers 1997 earnings view to $3.05 per share from $3.35, keeps 1998 earnings view at $3.95 per share
-- Lowered 1997 estimate reflects accounting changes announced earlier by First USA Inc. There are no further impediments to completing Banc One merger with First USA in June.
-- Stock is "cheap" based on 1998 earnings outlook
